summary: E-commerce/shop project with Admin Panel, UPI settings, Shop Status, Search, and Wallet features. Currently addressing critical admin lockout and authentication issues.
architectural_notes: Admin Panel at /admin requires Username+Password login; no access to settings without authentication
Database permissions must grant admin role to current session; UPI and Shop Status saves must write successfully
known_issues: Admin Panel shows 'Unauthorized' and 'Actor not available'; login screen has disappeared
Save buttons for UPI and Shop Status return 'Unauthorized' and fail to write to DB

existing_features.title: Reset admin authentication so that the AdminGuard component grants full admin access by default when no valid session exists, effectively bypassing the lockout. The hardcoded credentials in AdminLoginPage must be reset to a known default (e.g., username: 'admin', password: 'admin123') and the session creation logic must be verified to correctly write to localStorage/sessionStorage so that the AdminGuard recognizes it as valid.

Rebuild the /admin login page (AdminLoginPage.tsx) to always display a Username and Password input form. The login page must be visible at /admin/login (or /login as currently routed in App.tsx). Ensure App.tsx routes /admin and all /admin/* paths through AdminGuard, which redirects unauthenticated users to the login page. The login page itself must NOT be wrapped in AdminGuard. Verify TanStack Router route definitions so the login route is always reachable.

Fix the backend actor availability issue causing 'Actor not available' errors. In useQueries.ts, all mutations that write settings (UPI ID, shop status, slogan) must wait for the actor to be available before executing, and must handle the case where the actor is null/undefined gracefully with a clear error message. In the Motoko backend (backend/main.mo), verify that the admin-only write functions (setUpiId, setShopStatus, setSlogan, or equivalent) do not perform a principal-based authorization check that would reject calls from the frontend session — if they do, either remove the check or make it compatible with the anonymous/session-based admin flow being used.

Remove all 'Coming Soon' placeholder content from SearchPage.tsx, WalletPage.tsx, and MyOrdersPage.tsx. Replace them with real, functional implementations: (1) SearchPage must render a search input that filters products from the backend by name/category and displays results using ProductCard components. (2) WalletPage must display the user's wallet/cashback balance and transaction history if the backend supports it, or a basic wallet UI with balance display. (3) MyOrdersPage must display the current user's past orders fetched from the backend. Update BottomNavBar.tsx links for Search and Wallet to navigate to these now-functional pages.

new_feature_requests.summary: Force admin role: reset DB permissions to grant current session full admin access
Restore /admin login page with Username and Password fields, block settings access without login
Fix Save buttons for UPI and Shop Status to write to database without Unauthorized error
Remove all Coming Soon placeholders from Home page and activate Search and Wallet for real
